updatedEntries.rationale: Independently inspected the distinct stableBytes openSync sink in the reported CLI -> interpreter output -> receipt exchange flow. The script derives repositoryRoot from its own module location and the certification directory is constant. Its fixed Python bridge obtains exchanges only from local PROFILES and accepts certification_result success, whose strict identifier/profile checks and approved receipt pins precede output.
